description: This file defines API endpoints for managing service requests within a customer service portal backend. It uses FastAPI to expose HTTP routes for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, fetching history, and deleting service requests. The endpoints enforce role-based access control (customer and staff) and interact with underlying service and repository layers.

methods.name: ServiceRequestService _service(repo: Repository)
methods.description: Internal helper function that constructs a ServiceRequestService instance bound to a given repository.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead create_request( payload: ServiceRequestCreate, repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new service request. Enforces customer role.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] list_requests( status_filter: Optional[RequestStatus] = Query(default=None, alias="status", description="Filter by status"), priority: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by priority"), customer_email: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by customer email"), date_from: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Include requests created on/after this ISO date/datetime"), date_to: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Include requests created on/before this ISO date/datetime"), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of items to return"), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Number of items to skip"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list service requests with filters and pagination. Enforces staff role.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead get_request_by_id( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific service request by ID. Enforces staff role.

methods.name: ServiceRequestRead update_request_status( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), payload: ServiceRequestUpdateStatus = ..., repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update the status of a service request. Enforces staff role.

methods.name: list[RequestEventRead] get_request_history( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch the chronological event history of a service request. Enforces staff role.

methods.name: Response delete_request( request_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="Service request ID"), repo: Repository = Depends(get_repo), principal: Principal | None = Depends(get_principal), )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a service request. Enforces staff role. Handles NotFoundError if request does not exist.
